# FortuneTech

> FortuneTech (ftech.co.in) sets up and runs practical AI services for businesses and professionals worldwide, from Hyderabad, India. Services are delivered remotely, priced in US dollars, and nothing is published or sent in a client's name without their approval.

## Services

- AI Visibility & Profile Management: monthly management of how you appear in search results, on LinkedIn and in AI assistants. AI Visibility Fix $750 one-off; Fix + Content $1,500 one-off; optional Monthly Monitor $149/month after a fix. Starts with a free visibility audit.
- AI Chatbot Setup: a website assistant trained on your own products and policies. $600 setup plus $150/month.
- AI Content System: drafts social posts and articles in your brand voice; nothing posts until you approve it. $450 setup plus $250/month.
- Business Documents on Demand: proposals, tenders, reports and presentations, up to 10 a month. $300/month.
